b2c_apr_rule_desc:
Every hour, the market bids from the lowest lending APY upwards, based on borrowing demand. The highest bid is used as the current lending APY.

If minimum lending APY < current lending APY: Assets will be lent out with current lending interest APY.
If minimum lending APY > current lending APY: Assets will not be lent out, and no interest will be earned.
If minimum lending APY = current lending APY: Partial lending may occur, or none at all.

A percentage will be deducted from the market's current lending APY, based on your minimum lending APY and the total amount of funds that is being raised.

Your actual lending APY may be lower than the minimum lending APY, with interest returns determined by the final lending rate.
